theme: Paper snowflake with a counted instruction tape
title: Paper Snowflake: Minimal Fold/Punch Instruction Tape
strategies: punch every hole individually, zero folds (trivial)
fold only while the WHOLE sheet is exactly bilaterally symmetric, then punch (greedy) -- a single defect anywhere blocks all folding
interleave FOLD_X/FOLD_Y one level at a time, correcting individual mismatched cells the instant they would otherwise be lost, and stop at the instruction-minimizing depth (strong)
true minimum-instruction fold/punch program (open ceiling, uncovered)
